basics.name: Ahmad Hatahet
basics.title: Data Engineer
basics.summary: Data engineer with 5+ years and master in computer science transforming messy data into reliable pipelines, dashboards, and agentic AI workflows, across the automotive, telecom, and logistic sectors. Comfortable end-to-end: from SQL/NoSQL data modeling and ETL/ELT development to Python/Cloud-based automation and production LLM integration. What drives me is understanding what a business actually needs and building something usable around it, in cross-functional and collaboration teams who will rely on it.

experience.title: Artificial Intelligence Researcher
bullets: Gather client requirements and advise on the best-fit technical approach based on business needs and constraints.
Conduct in-depth analysis of each project's scope, data, and technical constraints before implementation begins.
Evaluate and discuss alternative solution strategies with stakeholders to align technical direction with business goals.
Run ad-hoc experiments to weigh the cost and benefit of candidate approaches before committing to one.
Architect and implement scalable solutions end-to-end using agile methodology, from prototype to production.
Develop custom toolsets (scripts, MCP servers, APIs) to automate client workflows and reduce manual effort.
Customize AI knowledge bases and fine-tune/train models (incl. reinforcement learning) for domain-specific tasks.
Track and evaluate state-of-the-art deep learning and multimodal LLM techniques to inform tooling decisions.

experience.title: Data Scientist
bullets: Owned the "Performance Tracker" project for Telefónica, measuring company performance per second spent by each agent.
Delivered a range of calculations requested by financial advisors through a Power BI dashboard for company stakeholders.
Engineered data pipelines from multiple sources into a SQL Server database using SSIS (SQL Server Integration Services).
Designed long-lasting, automated solutions for data challenges.
Monitored report performance and readability to ensure the dashboard remained reliable for stakeholders.
Document all functionality and data model.

experience.title: Freelance Business Analyst
bullets: Designed custom, automated Power BI and Excel reports for stakeholders using Power Query, DAX, and OLAP functionality.

experience.title: Business Analyst
bullets: Automated data pipelines and transformation to ensure data was clean and analysis-ready.
Designed dashboards to stakeholders on business stability, product performance, and expected shipments updates.
Led cost analyses for financial investment decisions and developed KPIs and automated reports for HR and other departments.
Built supporting models — e.g., an employee-wage estimation model and a product-reorder system factoring seasonal sales, stock, and shipping constraints.

experience.title: Product Support
bullets: Planned and assigned tasks to developer teams under Agile methodology and coordinated fixes with them directly.
Provided remote support for server configuration and resolved client tickets end-to-end.
Documented tasks and recurring issues for the wider support team and for future reference.
